あらすじ

One day, part-time worker Ryo Kayama goes for an interview for a live-in job.

The elegant Western-style mansion stands in a prime location in the city center.

After meeting the mansion’s owner, Mr. Yasuda, and under the guidance of senior maid Rina Miyauchi,

Kayama begins his life as a servant, and immediately falls in love with Mr. Yasuda’s daughter, Reika.

Walking around in school, she is suddenly attacked and “hugged” by Hechima, a lost “boy” out of nowhere.

School reports this as a result but when authorities prepare to take him away, Alice decides to take care of him.

item.title: Mesuinu Hatsujouki ~Kageriyuku Nichijou~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Drei
  • 発売日: 2012-03-30
  • スコア: 7.5200000000000005/10 (74 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 牝犬発情記 ～かげりゆく日常～
  • 英語名: Mesuinu Hatsujouki Kageriyuku Nichijou

别名

  • Mesuinu Hatsujouki Kageriyuku Nichijou

あらすじ

Miyuki is a full-time housewife who spends her days waiting for her husband to come home from work. They used to be a happy newly-married couple, but their marriage has stagnated, they barely speak to each other and Miyuki is beginning to feel lonely. One day an acquaintance of her husband comes by, he is going on a long business trip and asks if Miyuki can take care of his dog while he is away, and Miyuki agrees to this. She now spends her days walking, feeding and bathing the dog, and it doesn’t take long before the sexually starved Miyuki starts to take an interest in her new companion.
